rules: Gold, Deluxe and Ultimate labels do not prove a physical SKU.
A SteelBook can be a bonus item without a game.
Collector packaging does not prove that physical game media is included.
Preorder pages, store IDs and mockups do not prove a released physical product.
Code-in-box, Game-Key Card, download-required media and full physical game are distinct products.
Compilation components can mix physical media and vouchers.
Retailer bundles are not automatically publisher editions.
Outer product identifiers must remain separate from inner game identifiers.
A platform identifier incompatible with the target platform is a blocking conflict.
